rule.statement: The Commercial High Court had jurisdiction over the case at hand.
rule.supporting_quote: This Court holds that the Commercial High Court had jurisdiction over the case at hand and therefore the findings of the learned Judge of the Commercial High Court dated 09.1.2006 are affirmed.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: High Court of the Provinces (Special Provisions) Act No. 10 of 1996 read with Sections 754 and 758 of the Civil Procedure Code
